title: Inhibitor neurons on Qwen3-0.6B (knockout raises the answer)
method: Run 1's recall prompts and answers, concepts 0.6B has in reach (log-odds > -2 on >= 6 prompts). Attribution on half the prompts; the 20 most negative, 20 most positive, 20 random and 20 layer-matched random neurons each zeroed alone on the other half; change in mean exact log-odds. Inhibitor = bottom neuron raising the held-out answer above the null's 99th percentile.

title: Confidence (entropy) neurons on Qwen3-0.6B (entropy)
method: Candidates from weights (output vector's share in the unembedding's bottom 2% singular directions, x norm), layers 25-27; mean-ablated alone on 64 FineWeb windows; change in output entropy, total vs direct (final-norm scale frozen); nulls: 30 random neurons, 10 big ordinary-direction neurons.

title: Confidence (entropy) neurons on Qwen3-0.6B (entropy_v2)
method: Candidates from weights (output vector's share in the unembedding's bottom 2% singular directions, x norm x activation sd), layers 25-27; mean-ablated alone on 64 FineWeb windows; change in output entropy, total vs direct (final-norm scale frozen); nulls: 30 random neurons, 10 big ordinary-direction neurons.

title: Repeat / induction neurons on Qwen3-0.6B
method: 40 random tokens then either the same 40 (repeat) or 40 fresh ones (control); paired difference of mean second-half activation; effect size d selected on seeds 0-29, confirmed on 30-59; top 20 zeroed in the second half vs 20 random same-layer neurons.

title: Language-identity neurons on Qwen3-0.6B
method: 40 parallel sentences in en/fr/de/es/zh; per neuron AUC of mean activation for a language vs the rest, selected on sentences 0-19, confirmed on 20-39 (AUC >= 0.95 both); each language's top 20 zeroed, loss per token on held-out sentences of every language vs 20 random same-layer neurons.
